changelog: Adds eight settings for fall damage, health and mana regeneration, stamina, underwater breathing, weapon durability, cold protection and mana.

noFallDamage.label: No Fall Damage
noFallDamage.description: Turns off fall damage for players using the same character template.

fastHealthRegen.label: Fast Health Regen
fastHealthRegen.description: Increases health regeneration by up to 100 times. Requires natural health regeneration.

fastManaRegen.label: Fast Mana Regen
fastManaRegen.description: Increases mana regeneration by up to 100 times. Requires natural mana regeneration.

infiniteStamina.label: Infinite Stamina
infiniteStamina.description: Keeps stamina full and adjusts automatically when its maximum changes.

infiniteUnderwaterBreath.label: Infinite Underwater Breath
infiniteUnderwaterBreath.description: Keeps the underwater breath reserve full.

infiniteWeaponDurability.label: Infinite Weapon Durability
infiniteWeaponDurability.description: Disables durability loss for the entire hosted world, including items equipped by other players. Restores the previous world setting when disabled.

infiniteFrostTimer.label: Infinite Frost Timer
infiniteFrostTimer.description: Keeps body warmth at its maximum.

infiniteMana.label: Infinite Mana
infiniteMana.description: Keeps mana full and adjusts automatically when its maximum changes.

groups.label: Survival
groups.description: Turn individual survival options on or off. Changes are saved immediately.
